claim: Quimet & Quimet in Poble Sec is a family bodega since 1914 serving among the best montaditos in Barcelona, while Cal Pep lets you sit at the counter and watch seafood, fried fish and tortilla cooked in front of you.
quote: Quimet & Quimet in Poble Sec is a top pick - it has been a family bodega since 1914 and serves what many consider the best montaditos in Barcelona... Cal Pep is arguably the best tapas bar in Barcelona, where you can sit at the counter

claim: Time Out's critic picks include La Plata in El Gòtic (since 1945, six tables, fried whole anchovies), Bar Canyí in Sant Antoni (no reservations, mussels in escabeche, cap i pota) and Bodega Molina in Gràcia.
quote: La Plata (El Gòtic) - Historic establishment since 1945; six tables only - Essentials: fried whole anchovies, tomato salad, morcilla sausage pintxo

claim: Santa Caterina was Barcelona's first covered food market (1845), recognisable by its colourful Gaudí-inspired wavy roof, with only ~60 stalls and a more relaxed, less crowded atmosphere than La Boqueria.
quote: Santa Caterina was Barcelona's first covered food market, built in 1845... easily recognisable for its quirky, curved roof, adorned with colourful tiles meant to mimic the mosaic techniques of Antoni Gaudi... With only 60 food stalls

claim: La Boqueria is open 8am to 8:30pm Monday to Saturday, and the best time to visit is 8-10am when it is less crowded and chefs are shopping for the freshest ingredients.
quote: Mercat de la Boqueria is open from 8am to 8:30pm, Monday to Saturday. By far the best time to visit the market is between 8am and 10am in the morning, when things are less crowded and chefs peruse the stalls

claim: Sant Antoni market is a restored 19th-century iron-and-glass building (reopened 2018) with 300+ stalls where locals far outnumber tourists, and it hosts a second-hand book and collectables market on Sundays.
quote: a full city block of wrought iron and glass... a proper restoration in 2018. Locals outnumber tourists here by a lot... over 300 stalls... Sant Antoni market, which has a second-hand book and collectables market on Sundays

claim: Euskal Etxea in El Born (Placeta de Montcada 1) is the city's oldest Donostiarra Basque pintxo bar with pintxos around EUR1.20-1.70 and real barrel cider, while Bar Raspall in Gràcia still gives a free tapa with every drink.
quote: Euskal Etxea (Placeta de Montcada 1)... the oldest Donostiarra bar in the city with real barrel cider... Bar Raspall in Gracia still gives a free tapa with every drink, a tradition that has almost disappeared from Barcelona

claim: 'La hora del vermut' is the late-morning-to-early-afternoon aperitif ritual where vermut is served over ice with an orange slice and an olive; standout vermuterias include Morro Fi (Eixample) and Vermuteria del Tano (Gracia).
quote: La hora del vermut is from late morning to early afternoon, when it's traditionally served as an aperitif before lunchtime... served over ice with a zesty slice of orange and a bitter olive on the side

claim: Granja La Pallaresa (Petritxol 11, since 1947) and Granja Dulcinea (Petritxol 2, since 1941) anchor the Gòtic 'chocolate street' for churros con xocolata, while Xurreria Trebol in Gràcia is considered by many the city's best.
quote: Granja La Pallaresa (Gotico)... Established 1947... Granja Dulcinea (Gotico)... opened in 1941; frequented by Dali... Xurreria Trebol (Gracia)... many consider it Barcelona's best churros shop

claim: El Xampanyet (Carrer Montcada, El Born) is a historic 1930s bodega serving standing pintxos with its own house cava and anchovies near Santa Maria del Mar.
quote: El Xampanyet... historic bodega... house cava... near the Santa Maria del Mar

claim: Barcelona cooking classes typically follow a market-tour-plus-cook format starting at La Boqueria or Santa Caterina; Cook & Taste near La Boqueria is praised for small-group paella technique and Gastronomic Arts Barcelona holds a 4.9/5 rating.
quote: meet near La Boqueria or Santa Caterina market, shop for ingredients with a guide, walk to the kitchen, cook 3-5 dishes... Cook & Taste near La Boqueria has the best paella technique instruction
